adversarial_second_pass.independent_reconstruction: OAT deficiency directly impairs ornithine catabolism and produces marked hyperornithinemia; the retinal phenotype is classic gyrate atrophy.
adversarial_second_pass.strongest_distractor_attack: Homocysteine, phenylalanine, branched-chain ketoacids, and methylmalonic acid belong to different inborn errors and are not substrates accumulating from OAT deficiency.
adversarial_second_pass.expert_reviewer_reversal: The stem already documents marked ornithine elevation and OAT variants, making accumulation of ornithine direct and unique; easy difficulty is appropriate.
